import numpy as np

# Data for FY 1953 to FY 1962 (from Table 2: Monetary Stocks of Gold and Silver)
# Gold ($35 per fine ounce) - Independent variable (X)
# Silver ($1.29+ per fine ounce) - Dependent variable (Y)

years = list(range(1953, 1963))  # FY 1953 to FY 1962

# Gold holdings (in millions)
gold = [22462.8, 21927.0, 21677.6, 21799.1, 22622.9, 21356.2, 19704.6, 19322.2, 17550.2, 16435.2]

# Silver holdings (in millions) 
silver = [3814.3, 3863.1, 3922.4, 3994.5, 4116.6, 4306.0, 4414.1, 4394.5, 4346.5, 4317.4]

print("FY | Gold    | Silver")
print("-" * 30)
for i, year in enumerate(years):
    print(f"{year} | {gold[i]:7.1f} | {silver[i]:5.1f}")

# Convert to numpy arrays
X = np.array(gold)
Y = np.array(silver)

# Perform linear regression: silver = beta0 + beta1 * gold
# Using least squares
n = len(X)
sum_x = np.sum(X)
sum_y = np.sum(Y)
sum_xy = np.sum(X * Y)
sum_x2 = np.sum(X**2)

# Calculate slope (beta1) and intercept (beta0)
beta1 = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_x2 - sum_x**2)
beta0 = (sum_y - beta1 * sum_x) / n

print(f"\nLinear Regression: Silver = {beta0:.4f} + {beta1:.6f} * Gold")
print(f"Intercept (beta0): {beta0:.4f}")
print(f"Slope (beta1): {beta1:.6f}")

# Calculate predicted values
Y_pred = beta0 + beta1 * X

# Calculate R-squared
# SST = sum((Y - mean(Y))^2)
# SSR = sum((Y_pred - mean(Y))^2)
# R^2 = SSR / SST

mean_y = np.mean(Y)
SST = np.sum((Y - mean_y)**2)
SSR = np.sum((Y_pred - mean_y)**2)
R_squared = SSR / SST

print(f"\nR-squared: {R_squared:.6f}")
print(f"R-squared (rounded to 2 decimal places): {round(R_squared, 2)}")

EOF

import math

# Data for FY 1953 to FY 1962 (from Table 2: Monetary Stocks of Gold and Silver)
# Gold ($35 per fine ounce) - Independent variable (X)
# Silver ($1.29+ per fine ounce) - Dependent variable (Y)

years = list(range(1953, 1963))  # FY 1953 to FY 1962

# Gold holdings (in millions)
gold = [22462.8, 21927.0, 21677.6, 21799.1, 22622.9, 21356.2, 19704.6, 19322.2, 17550.2, 16435.2]

# Silver holdings (in millions) 
silver = [3814.3, 3863.1, 3922.4, 3994.5, 4116.6, 4306.0, 4414.1, 4394.5, 4346.5, 4317.4]

print("FY | Gold    | Silver")
print("-" * 30)
for i, year in enumerate(years):
    print(f"{year} | {gold[i]:7.1f} | {silver[i]:5.1f}")

# Convert to arrays
X = gold
Y = silver
n = len(X)

# Calculate sums
sum_x = sum(X)
sum_y = sum(Y)
sum_xy = sum([x*y for x,y in zip(X,Y)])
sum_x2 = sum([x**2 for x in X])
sum_y2 = sum([y**2 for y in Y])

# Calculate slope (beta1) and intercept (beta0)
beta1 = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_x2 - sum_x**2)
beta0 = (sum_y - beta1 * sum_x) / n

print(f"\nLinear Regression: Silver = {beta0:.4f} + {beta1:.6f} * Gold")
print(f"Intercept (beta0): {beta0:.4f}")
print(f"Slope (beta1): {beta1:.6f}")

# Calculate predicted values
Y_pred = [beta0 + beta1 * x for x in X]

# Calculate R-squared
mean_y = sum_y / n
SST = sum([(y - mean_y)**2 for y in Y])
SSR = sum([(y_pred - mean_y)**2 for y_pred in Y_pred])
R_squared = SSR / SST

print(f"\nR-squared: {R_squared:.6f}")
print(f"R-squared (rounded to 2 decimal places): {round(R_squared, 2)}")

# Also calculate correlation coefficient for verification
r = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / math.sqrt((n * sum_x2 - sum_x**2) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y**2))
print(f"Correlation coefficient r: {r:.6f}")
print(f"r^2: {r**2:.6f}")

EOF
